decisions.reason: As a premium support offer close to the firm's core agency-focused service model, it fits the publicly stated strategy and is easy for management to justify continuing despite any mixed results.

The version management tool builds directly on the firm's platform development, was given its own page and named publicly among current innovations, so sunk development effort and visible commitment favor persistence.

Although it had a dedicated page, the data-processing-contract tool is more distant from the hosting core, so if traction has remained unclear management has less strategic reason to keep justifying it and is more likely to redeploy resources.
Scalable hosting for agencies is highly aligned with the firm's main business and appeared on the home page, making it a visible strategic commitment that management is likely to continue backing.
